The '''magna-gun''' was a powerful brand of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. During his campaign for power in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Shogar Tok]] took control of the magna-guns and established them at his [[Shogar Tok's fortress|fortress]] on the world. They were [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] during the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal IV]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
